# SandboxProbe

`schemas/api/sandbox-probe.json`

What the fixed sandbox probe saw in one run (docs/design/m1/00-slice-plan.md P9), the answer to POST /v1/dev/sandbox-probe (operator only). An empty violations list is a pass: no network, an empty HOME, no controller path, no mount from the host but the run's own, no capability, no_new_privs and seccomp, the limits in force, and no socket but the gateway's, which a build run must have.
